# BLACKDARK Data Processing Addendum (Template)

**Status:** Product-complete signable template  
**Version:** 1.0

## Roles
Customer = Controller · BLACKDARK = Processor (for Customer Content). Platform telemetry processed as Controller where lawful.

## Processing
Purpose: provide Trust OS decision and evidence services.  
Categories: account identity, org membership, usage events, decision audit hashes.  
No sale of personal data.

## Security
Encryption in transit; secrets via vault; org isolation `org_id_scoped_v1`; MFA enforceable per org.

## Subprocessors
Listed on request; material changes notified.

## Deletion / export
GDPR export/erase endpoints honor DSR within policy windows.

## Signatures
Via institutional contracts API.
